pairs.note: CFlies_dtor. core_flies.cpp and 101B on both sides. The strict shape hash cannot separate these destructors: their only build-invariant constant is the object size handed to operator delete, and sizeof(CFlies) in nocedit (360) equals sizeof(CStairs) in nocturne (360), so the seed matched one step along the size ladder.
CStairs_dtor. core_stairs.cpp and 101B on both sides. Same size-ladder collision: sizeof(CStairs) nocedit 368 == sizeof(CBat) nocturne 368.
CBat_dtor. core_bat.cpp and 101B on both sides. Third link of the same rotation; nocedit 376 -> nocturne 368.
